BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to refilling eye drop prescriptions; and adding anew section to chapter 18.64 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.64 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A pharmacist is authorized, without consulting a physician orobtaining a new prescription or refill from a physician, to provide forone early refill of a prescription for eye drops to treat glaucoma ifall of the following criteria are met: (1) The refill is requested by a patient less than thirty daysafter the later of: (a) The date the original prescription was dispensed to thepatient; or (b) The date that the last refill of the prescription was dispensedto the patient; (2) The prescriber indicates on the original prescription that aspecific number of refills will be needed; (3) The refill does not exceed the number of refills that theprescriber indicated under subsection (2) of this section; p. 1 SB 6575 (4) The prescription has not been refilled more than once duringthe thirtyday period prior to the request for an early refill.
